declarations.text: I am blessed with favor that makes my name great in my community.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will make you into a great nation, and I will bless you; I will make your name great.

declarations.text: I receive favor that brings me into the presence of great people.
declarations.bibleVerseText: A gift opens the way and ushers the giver into the presence of the great.

declarations.text: I am experiencing the year of the Lord’s favor in every part of my life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: To proclaim the year of the Lord’s favor.

declarations.text: I thank God for the favor that is resting on me and my family right now.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But Noah found favor in the eyes of the Lord.

declarations.text: God gives me the power and the ability to produce wealth.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But remember the Lord your God, for it is he who gives you the ability to produce wealth.

declarations.text: I am successful in everything I do because I meditate on God's Word.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Then you will be prosperous and successful.

declarations.text: I have more than enough to meet my needs and to help others in need.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And God is able to bless you abundantly, so that in all things at all times... you will abound in every good work.

declarations.text: God is opening the windows of heaven and pouring out a blessing I cannot contain.
declarations.bibleVerseText: See if I will not throw open the floodgates of heaven and pour out so much blessing that there will not be room enough to store it.

declarations.text: I am debt-free and I am the lender and not the borrower.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You will lend to many nations but will borrow from none.

declarations.text: Wealth and riches are in my house because I follow the ways of the Lord.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Wealth and riches are in their houses, and their righteousness endures forever.

declarations.text: Every business deal I touch turns into a great success because God is with me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord will send a blessing on your barns and on everything you put your hand to.

declarations.text: I have plenty of resources to finish every project God has given me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And my God will meet all your needs according to the riches of his glory in Christ Jesus.

declarations.text: I am a wise steward of money and my wealth continues to grow.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Dishonest money dwindles away, but whoever gathers money little by little makes it grow.

declarations.text: I am blessed to be a blessing to my family and my community.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will bless you... and you will be a blessing.

declarations.text: I am free from the fear of lack because the Lord is my Shepherd.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord is my shepherd, I lack nothing.

declarations.text: I serve the God who multiplied loaves, filled nets, and provided from unexpected places — my source is supernatural.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And my God will meet all your needs according to the riches of his glory in Christ Jesus.

declarations.text: I am an heir to the riches of God and I receive my inheritance today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So you are no longer a slave, but God’s child; and since you are his child, God has made you also an heir.

declarations.text: I am successful in my work and I am rewarded for my hard labor.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You will eat the fruit of your labor; blessings and prosperity will be yours.

declarations.text: God is bringing me into a large and wealthy place in my life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: We went through fire and water, but you brought us to a place of abundance.

declarations.text: I have the wisdom to create multiple streams of income for my future.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Invest in seven ventures, yes, in eight; you do not know what disaster may come upon the land.

declarations.text: I am leaving a financial inheritance for my children and my grandchildren.
declarations.bibleVerseText: A good man leaves an inheritance to his children's children.

declarations.text: The blessing of the Lord is making me rich without any added sorrow.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The blessing of the Lord brings wealth, without painful toil for it.

declarations.text: I am a generous person and I am being refreshed by God’s abundance.
declarations.bibleVerseText: A generous person will prosper; whoever refreshes others will be refreshed.

declarations.text: I am experiencing God’s best in my finances and in my health.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Dear friend, I pray that you may enjoy good health and that all may go well with you.

declarations.text: I am blessed in the city and blessed in the field.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You will be blessed in the city and blessed in the country.

declarations.text: I have creative ideas that generate wealth and help many people.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I, wisdom, dwell together with prudence; I possess knowledge and discretion.

declarations.text: I am a cheerful giver and God is multiplying what I sow.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Now he who supplies seed to the sower... will also supply and increase your store of seed.

declarations.text: I am rich in every way so that I can be generous on every occasion.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You will be enriched in every way so that you can be generous on every occasion.

declarations.text: I am thankful for the wealth and abundance that is flowing into my life now.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Praise be to the Lord, to God our Savior, who daily bears our burdens.

declarations.text: I am not ruled by fear because the same God who holds the universe holds my life right now.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So do not fear, for I am with you; do not be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you and help you.

declarations.text: I have a calm and sound mind because God did not give me a spirit of fear.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power and of love and of a sound mind.

declarations.text: I trade my worries for prayer and I receive a peace that makes no sense to the world.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do not be anxious about anything, but in every situation, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God.

declarations.text: I sleep deeply and peacefully because God is watching over me while I rest.
declarations.bibleVerseText: When you lie down, you will not be afraid; when you lie down, your sleep will be sweet.

declarations.text: I am not shaken by bad news because my heart is firmly trusting in the Lord.
declarations.bibleVerseText: They will have no fear of bad news; their hearts are steadfast, trusting in the Lord.

declarations.text: I bring my anxiety to God and He returns it to me as His peace.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Cast all your anxiety on him because he cares for you.

declarations.text: I am hidden in the God who spoke creation into existence and calls me His own, and in Him alone is my true safety.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord is my light and my salvation — whom shall I fear? The Lord is the stronghold of my life — of whom shall I be afraid?

declarations.text: Because tomorrow is already in God's hands, I refuse to spend today living in a future He has already covered.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore do not worry about tomorrow, for tomorrow will worry about itself. Each day has enough trouble of its own.

declarations.text: I am bold and courageous because the Lord my God goes with me everywhere.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Have I not commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged, for the Lord your God will be with you wherever you go.

declarations.text: I quiet my soul and find rest in the presence of the Almighty.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Truly my soul finds rest in God; my salvation comes from him.

declarations.text: I am protected by a peace that guards my heart and my thoughts today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And the peace of God, which transcends all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.

declarations.text: Even when fear rises in my chest, I place every trembling part of me into the hands of God who holds it all.
declarations.bibleVerseText: When I am afraid, I put my trust in you.

declarations.text: I am free from all my fears because God heard my cry and rescued me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I sought the Lord, and he answered me; he delivered me from all my fears.

declarations.text: Christ left me a peace the world cannot give or take away, and it stands as a permanent anchor for my soul.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Peace I leave with you; my peace I give you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled and do not be afraid.

declarations.text: I am hidden in God’s shadow where no evil can touch my mind.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He will cover you with his feathers, and under his wings you will find refuge.

declarations.text: I don't fight anxiety alone because the peace of God stands guard over my mind like a soldier who never sleeps.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And the peace of God, which transcends all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.

declarations.text: I choose what I dwell on and because I choose truth over fear, that daily decision reshapes my mind according to God's Word.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely — think about such things.

declarations.text: I am not a slave to fear because I am a child of God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For you did not receive a spirit that makes you a slave again to fear, but you received the spirit of sonship.

declarations.text: I walk through the dark valleys of life with total confidence because God is by my side.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Even though I walk through the darkest valley, I will fear no evil, for you are with me.

declarations.text: I keep my mind stayed on God and He keeps me in perfect peace.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You will keep in perfect peace those whose minds are steadfast, because they trust in you.

declarations.text: I submit myself fully to God and resist every spirit of fear, knowing it has no authority over the life I carry in Christ.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Submit yourselves, then, to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

declarations.text: I hear the voice of God clearly, and it leads me out of danger and into a safety that the world cannot offer or explain.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But whoever listens to me will live in safety and be at ease, without fear of harm.

declarations.text: Because the Lord is my defender, I will not shrink before any threat, diagnosis, or person who comes against me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So we say with confidence, 'The Lord is my helper; I will not be afraid. What can mere mortals do to me?'

declarations.text: I am full of God's love which drives out every trace of fear in me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: There is no fear in love. But perfect love drives out fear.

declarations.text: I close each day resting in the quietness and trust that God Himself calls my true strength.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In quietness and trust is your strength.

declarations.text: I am not giving up because I know I will see God's goodness in my life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I remain confident of this: I will see the goodness of the Lord in the land of the living.

declarations.text: I am coming out of this trouble stronger and better than I was before.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But he knows the way that I take; when he has tested me, I will come forth as gold.

declarations.text: I have the strength to get through this because God is my power.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I can do all this through him who gives me strength.

declarations.text: I refuse to be discouraged because my current troubles are only temporary.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For our light and momentary troubles are achieving for us an eternal glory that far outweighs them all.

declarations.text: I am more than a conqueror even in the middle of this difficult season.
declarations.bibleVerseText: No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.

declarations.text: God is using this difficult situation to work out something good for me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And we know that in all things God works for the good of those who love him.

declarations.text: I am not alone in this fire because God is walking right beside me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you.

declarations.text: I have a peace that stays steady even when everything around me is shaking.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Peace I leave with you; my peace I give you... Do not let your hearts be troubled.

declarations.text: I am holding onto my hope because God is faithful to His promises.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Let us hold unswervingly to the hope we profess, for he who promised is faithful.

declarations.text: I will not be crushed by this pressure because God provides a way out.
declarations.bibleVerseText: We are hard pressed on every side, but not crushed; perplexed, but not in despair.

declarations.text: In the place of my greatest weakness, God's power shows up strongest — and I am not ashamed of that.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But he said to me, 'My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.'

declarations.text: I am choosing to be joyful because my victory is already won.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But thanks be to God! He gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

declarations.text: I am standing firm on the Rock and I will not be moved by this storm.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The rain came down... yet it did not fall, because it had its foundation on the rock.

declarations.text: I am expecting a miracle to happen in the middle of my struggle.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Jesus looked at them and said, 'With man this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.'

declarations.text: I am not afraid of the dark because God is my light and my salvation.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord is my light and my salvation—whom shall I fear?

declarations.text: I am being refined and made better through every test I face.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Consider it pure joy... whenever you face trials of many kinds, because you know that the testing of your faith produces perseverance.

declarations.text: I have the grace I need to handle whatever happens today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.

declarations.text: I am walking by faith and not by what I see around me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For we live by faith, not by sight.

declarations.text: I refuse to worry because God is taking care of all my needs.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And my God will meet all your needs according to the riches of his glory.

declarations.text: I am full of courage because the Lord is my helper.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So we say with confidence, 'The Lord is my helper; I will not be afraid.'

declarations.text: I am resting in the fact that God is fighting this battle for me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord will fight for you; you need only to be still.

declarations.text: I am patient and I will wait for God to turn this around.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Be still before the Lord and wait patiently for him.

declarations.text: I am keeping my head up because God is the one who lifts me up.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But you, Lord, are a shield around me, my glory, the One who lifts my head high.

declarations.text: I am confident that this season of weeping will end in a season of joy.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Weeping may stay for the night, but rejoicing comes in the morning.

declarations.text: I am a winner because Jesus has already overcome the world.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In this world you will have trouble. But take heart! I have overcome the world.

declarations.text: I am free from every chain because the Son has set me free.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So if the Son sets you free, you will be free indeed.

declarations.text: I have the power to say no to wrong desires through the Holy Spirit.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For the Spirit God gave us does not make us timid, but gives us power, love and self-discipline.

declarations.text: I am not a slave to my past or my habits anymore.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For we know that our old self was crucified with him so that... we should no longer be slaves to sin.

declarations.text: I am a new creation and my old ways of living have passed away.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore, if anyone is in Christ, the new creation has come: The old has gone, the new is here!

declarations.text: I am stronger than any craving because God provides a way of escape.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And God is faithful... he will also provide a way out so that you can endure it.

declarations.text: I am renewing my mind every day with the truth of God's Word.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do not conform to the pattern of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind.

declarations.text: I am putting on the armor of light and walking away from the darkness.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The night is nearly over; the day is almost here. So let us put aside the deeds of darkness and put on the armor of light.

declarations.text: I am clean and pure because of the blood of Jesus Christ.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But if we walk in the light... the blood of Jesus, his Son, purifies us from all sin.

declarations.text: I am taking every thought captive and making it obey Christ.
declarations.bibleVerseText: We demolish arguments... and we take captive every thought to make it obedient to Christ.

declarations.text: I am finding my satisfaction in God and not in temporary things.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For he satisfies the thirsty and fills the hungry with good things.

declarations.text: I am standing firm in the freedom that Christ has given to me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: It is for freedom that Christ has set us free. Stand firm, then, and do not let yourselves be burdened again by a yoke of slavery.

declarations.text: I am more than a conqueror over every temptation that comes my way.
declarations.bibleVerseText: No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.

declarations.text: I am a temple of the Holy Spirit and I honor God with my body.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do you not know that your bodies are temples of the Holy Spirit... Therefore honor God with your bodies.

declarations.text: I am walking in the Spirit so I do not fulfill the desires of the flesh.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So I say, walk by the Spirit, and you will not gratify the desires of the flesh.

declarations.text: I am forgiven and I refuse to live in shame or guilt.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore, there is now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus.

declarations.text: I am breaking every generational cycle of addiction in my family line.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law by becoming a curse for us.

declarations.text: I am choosing life and blessing today instead of death and destruction.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Now choose life, so that you and your children may live.

declarations.text: I am not fighting this battle alone — God puts people in my path who carry me when I can't walk.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore confess your sins to each other and pray for each other so that you may be healed.

declarations.text: Though I fall, I rise again — because the Lord upholds me with His hand and shame does not get the last word.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Though he may stumble, he will not fall, for the Lord upholds him with his hand.

declarations.text: I am letting God's power be made perfect in my areas of weakness.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But he said to me, 'My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.'

declarations.text: I am filled with the peace of God which keeps my heart steady.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And the peace of God... will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.

declarations.text: I am confident that God will finish the work of freedom He started in me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Being confident of this, that he who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion.

declarations.text: I am no longer controlled by anything except the love of God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For Christ’s love compels us.

declarations.text: I am walking in the light and the darkness has no power over me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness has not overcome it.

declarations.text: I am totally delivered and I will share my story to help others.
declarations.bibleVerseText: They triumphed over him by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of their testimony.

declarations.text: I am created in the image of God and I carry His likeness in everything I do.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So God created mankind in his own image, in the image of God he created them.

declarations.text: I am blessed by God to be fruitful, to multiply, and to have dominion in the earth.
declarations.bibleVerseText: God blessed them and said to them, 'Be fruitful and increase in number; fill the earth and subdue it.'

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I am a masterpiece because everything God made in me is very good— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: God saw all that he had made, and it was very good.

declarations.text: I have the breath of life from God inside of me, making me a living soul.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Then the Lord God formed a man... and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life.

declarations.text: I walk in the garden of God’s presence and I enjoy fellowship with Him every day.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Then the man and his wife heard the sound of the Lord God as he was walking in the garden.

declarations.text: I am a person of faith and I walk in close friendship with God just like Enoch.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Enoch walked faithfully with God.

declarations.text: I find favor in the eyes of the Lord even in the middle of a difficult world.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But Noah found favor in the eyes of the Lord.

declarations.text: I am a blessing to others and my name is great because God has blessed me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will make you into a great nation, and I will bless you; I will make your name great, and you will be a blessing.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I am not afraid because God is my shield and my very great reward— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do not be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, your very great reward.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I am counted as righteous because I believe in the promises of the Lord— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Abram believed the Lord, and he credited it to him as righteousness.

declarations.text: I serve the God Who Sees Me and He knows exactly where I am and what I need.
declarations.bibleVerseText: She gave this name to the Lord who spoke to her: 'You are the God who sees me.'

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I walk before God Almighty and I am being made blameless by His power— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I am God Almighty; walk before me faithfully and be blameless.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I serve a God for whom nothing is too hard or impossible— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Is anything too hard for the Lord?

declarations.text: I am a friend of God and He reveals His plans and His wisdom to me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Then the Lord said, 'Shall I hide from Abraham what I am about to do?'

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: God is with me in everything I do, granting me success and victory— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: God is with you in everything you do.

declarations.text: The Lord is my provider and He sees to it that all my needs are met.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So Abraham called that place The Lord Will Provide.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I receive a hundredfold return on what I plant because the Lord blesses me— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Isaac planted crops in that land and the same year reaped a hundredfold, because the Lord blessed him.

declarations.text: The Lord is in this place and He is watching over me wherever I go.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Surely the Lord is in this place... I am with you and will watch over you wherever you go.

declarations.text: I am a person who wrestles for my blessing and I will not let go until I see it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will not let you go unless you bless me.

declarations.text: I have a new identity in God and I am an overcomer in every situation.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Your name will no longer be Jacob, but Israel, because you have struggled with God and with humans and have overcome.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I am a prosperous person because the Lord’s presence is always with me— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord was with Joseph so that he prospered.

declarations.text: I have the Spirit of God in me, giving me discernment and wisdom above others.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Can we find anyone like this man, one in whom is the spirit of God?

declarations.text: God has made me fruitful in the land of my struggle and I am moving forward.
declarations.bibleVerseText: It is because God has made me fruitful in the land of my suffering.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: What the enemy meant for my harm, God is turning around for my good— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You intended to harm me, but God intended it for good.

declarations.text: I am not afraid because God has promised to provide for me and my family.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So then, don’t be afraid. I will provide for you and your children.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I am holy and set apart because the Lord my God is holy— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Be holy because I, the Lord your God, am holy.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I love my neighbor as myself and I treat everyone with kindness— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Love your neighbor as yourself. I am the Lord.

declarations.text: I walk in God's statutes and I receive the rain of blessing in its season.
declarations.bibleVerseText: If you follow my decrees... I will send you rain in its season, and the ground will yield its crops.

declarations.text: I have so much provision that I have to clear out the old to make room for the new.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You will still be eating last year’s harvest when you will have to move it out to make room for the new.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I live in a place of peace and I lie down without any fear— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will grant peace in the land, and you will lie down and no one will make you afraid.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I am victorious in battle and my enemies fall before me— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You will pursue your enemies, and they will fall by the sword before you.

declarations.text: Five of us can chase a hundred, and a hundred of us can chase ten thousand.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Five of you will chase a hundred, and a hundred of you will chase ten thousand.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: God looks upon me with favor and makes me fruitful and productive— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will look on you with favor and make you fruitful and increase your numbers.

declarations.text: The Lord walks among me and He is my God and I am His person.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will walk among you and be your God, and you will be my people.

declarations.text: I walk with my head held high because God has broken the chains of my slavery.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I broke the bars of your yoke and enabled you to walk with heads held high.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I am consecrated to God and I keep myself pure for His use— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Consecrate yourselves and be holy, because I am the Lord your God.

declarations.text: I am careful to do what is right so that I may live in the land God has given me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Keep all my decrees and laws and follow them, so that the land... will not vomit you out.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I distinguish between what is holy and what is common in my daily life— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You must distinguish between the holy and the common, between the unclean and the clean.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I honor the elderly and show respect for those who have gone before me— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Stand up in the presence of the aged, show respect for the elderly and revere your God.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I am honest in all my business dealings and I use fair scales— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Use honest scales and honest weights, an honest ephah and an honest hin.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I am the Lord's and I belong to Him forever— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You are to be holy to me because I, the Lord, am holy, and I have set you apart from the nations to be my own.

declarations.text: I celebrate the goodness of God and I am full of joy during His feasts.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Rejoice before the Lord your God for seven days.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: The fire of God is always burning on the altar of my heart— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The fire must be kept burning on the altar continuously; it must not go out.

declarations.text: I am a person of integrity and I do not cheat or lie to my neighbor.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do not steal. Do not lie. Do not deceive one another.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I do not hold a grudge, but I forgive from my heart— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do not seek revenge or bear a grudge against anyone among your people.

declarations.text: I am light and I do not put a stumbling block in front of the blind.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do not curse the deaf or put a stumbling block in front of the blind.

declarations.text: I stand for justice and I do not show favoritism to the great or the small.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do not pervert justice; do not show partiality to the poor or favoritism to the great.

declarations.text: I am a faithful tither and I honor God with the first of my increase.
declarations.bibleVerseText: A tithe of everything from the land... belongs to the Lord; it is holy to the Lord.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I am released from my debts and I walk in the year of Jubilee— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Consecrate the fiftieth year and proclaim liberty throughout the land.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I am safe and secure because I obey the commands of my God— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Follow my decrees and be careful to obey my laws, and you will live safely in the land.

declarations.text: I am delivered from every form of bondage because the Lord has heard my cry.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I have indeed seen the misery of my people... I have heard them crying out... and I have come down to rescue them.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: The Great 'I AM' is with me, providing everything I need for my journey— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: God said to Moses, 'I AM WHO I AM. This is what you are to say to the Israelites: I AM has sent me to you.'

declarations.text: I will be still and trust God because He is fighting the battle for me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord will fight for you; you need only to be still.

declarations.text: I am moving forward in faith and the obstacles in front of me are parting.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Then the Lord said to Moses, 'Why are you crying out to me? Tell the Israelites to move on.'

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: The Lord is my strength and my song; He has become my total victory— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord is my strength and my defense; he has become my salvation.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I serve the Lord who heals me and keeps my body in perfect health— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I am the Lord, who heals you.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I have fresh provision every single morning because God is my provider— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Israelites... gathered it each morning, as much as they needed.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: The Lord is my Banner and I win every fight under His leadership— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Moses built an altar and called it The Lord is my Banner.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I am God’s treasured possession and I am set apart for His holy purpose— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Now if you obey me fully and keep my covenant, then out of all nations you will be my treasured possession.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I honor my parents so that I will live a long and blessed life— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Honor your father and your mother, so that you may live long in the land.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I worship the Lord alone and His blessing is on my food and water— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Worship the Lord your God, and his blessing will be on your food and water.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: God is taking all sickness away from me and my family— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will take away sickness from among you.

declarations.text: I will live a full life and fulfill the number of my days on earth.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will give you a full life span.

declarations.text: God is sending His angels ahead of me to guard me and lead me to my destiny.
declarations.bibleVerseText: See, I am sending an angel ahead of you to guard you along the way and to bring you to the place I have prepared.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I am an overcomer because God sends His terror before my enemies— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will send my terror ahead of you and throw into confusion every nation you encounter.

declarations.text: I am skillful and talented because God has filled me with His Spirit and wisdom.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I have filled him with the Spirit of God, with wisdom, with understanding, with knowledge and with all kinds of skills.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: The presence of God goes with me and gives me total rest— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord replied, 'My Presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.'

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I am distinguished and different from the world because God is with me— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: How will anyone know that you are pleased with me... unless you go with us? What else will distinguish me and your people?

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I serve a God who is compassionate, gracious, and slow to anger— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord, the Lord, the compassionate and gracious God, slow to anger, abounding in love and faithfulness.

declarations.text: I am seeing wonders and miracles in my life that have never been done before.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Before all your people I will do wonders never before done in any nation in all the world.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I shine with the glory of God because I spend time in His presence— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: When Moses came down from Mount Sinai... his face was radiant because he had spoken with the Lord.

declarations.text: I am a generous giver and I bring my best to the work of the Lord.
declarations.bibleVerseText: All who were willing and whose hearts moved them came and brought an offering to the Lord.

declarations.text: I have a heart that is willing to learn and a mind that is quick to understand.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And he has given both him and Oholiab the ability to teach others.

declarations.text: The glory of the Lord fills my life and my home like a cloud of protection.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Then the cloud covered the tent of meeting, and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I follow the leading of the Lord whether by day or by night— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So the cloud of the Lord was over the tabernacle by day, and fire was in the cloud by night.

declarations.text: I am taking possession of every place where I set my foot, just as God promised.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will give you every place where you set your foot, as I promised Moses.

declarations.text: No enemy can stand against me all the days of my life because God is with me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: No one will be able to stand against you all the days of your life. As I was with Moses, so I will be with you.

declarations.text: I am strong and courageous because the Lord my God is with me wherever I go.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Be strong and courageous... for the Lord your God will be with you wherever you go.

declarations.text: I meditate on God’s Word day and night so that I will be prosperous and successful.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Keep this Book of the Law always on your lips; meditate on it day and night... Then you will be prosperous and successful.

declarations.text: I do not turn to the left or to the right; I stay focused on the path of victory.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do not turn from it to the right or to the left, that you may be successful wherever you go.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I am crossing my Jordan and entering into the fullness of my inheritance— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Now then, you and all these people, get ready to cross the Jordan River into the land I am about to give to them.

declarations.text: The obstacles in my path are moving because I follow the presence of the Living God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: As soon as the priests who carry the ark of the Lord... set foot in the Jordan, its waters flowing downstream will be cut off.

declarations.text: I am consecrated to God and I expect Him to do amazing things among us tomorrow.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Consecrate yourselves, for tomorrow the Lord will do amazing things among you.

declarations.text: I serve the God who is exalted, and He is making my name great in the land.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Today I will begin to exalt you in the eyes of all Israel.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I have a memorial of God’s faithfulness that reminds me He will always provide— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: These stones are to be a memorial to the people of Israel forever.

declarations.text: The reproach of my past is rolled away and I walk in a new identity.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Today I have rolled away the reproach of Egypt from you.

declarations.text: I eat the fruit of the land and I enjoy the abundance of my current season.
declarations.bibleVerseText: They ate some of the produce of the land: unleavened bread and roasted grain.

declarations.text: I am standing on holy ground and I am aligned with the Commander of the Lord’s army.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Take off your sandals, for the place where you are standing is holy.

declarations.text: I shout in victory because the Lord has given me the city and the breakthrough.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Shout! For the Lord has given you the city!

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: The walls of opposition are falling down flat before me— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: When the trumpets sounded... the wall collapsed.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I am not afraid or discouraged; I take my position and claim my win— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged. Take the whole army with you, and go up and attack Ai.

declarations.text: I am reaching out my hand in authority and God is giving me the victory.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Stretch out toward Ai the javelin that is in your hand, for into your hand I will deliver the city.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: The sun and moon stand still for me until my mission is fully accomplished— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Sun, stand still over Gibeon, and you, moon, over the Valley of Aijalon.

declarations.text: I am putting my feet on the necks of my enemies; I have total dominion.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Come here and put your feet on the necks of these kings.

declarations.text: I am as strong today as I was years ago; I am ready for the battle.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I am still as strong today as the day Moses sent me out; I’m just as vigorous to go out to battle now.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I am bold enough to say: Give me this mountain!— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Now give me this hill country that the Lord promised me that day.

declarations.text: Not one of God’s good promises to me has failed; every one has come true.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Not one of all the Lord’s good promises to Israel failed; every one was fulfilled.

declarations.text: I hold fast to the Lord my God just as I have done until this day.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But you are to hold fast to the Lord your God, as you have until now.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: As for me and my household, we will serve the Lord— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But as for me and my household, we will serve the Lord.

declarations.text: I am a witness to God’s goodness and I keep my heart fully committed to Him.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Yield your hearts to the Lord, the God of Israel.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: The Lord is with me, and I am going up to possess my victory— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord was with the men of Judah. They took possession of the hill country.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I am a mighty warrior, and the Lord is with me— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The angel of the Lord appeared to Gideon and said, 'The Lord is with you, mighty warrior.'

declarations.text: I go in the strength I have, and I am the one God is sending to save.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Go in the strength you have... Am I not sending you?

declarations.text: I am not defined by my background; I am defined by God's call on my life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Pardon me, my lord... but my clan is the weakest... and I am the least in my family.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I have peace because the Lord is my peace— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So Gideon built an altar to the Lord there and called it The Lord Is Peace.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: The Spirit of the Lord clothes me with power to lead and to win— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Then the Spirit of the Lord came on Gideon, and he blew a trumpet.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I am chosen because I am alert, prepared, and ready for the task— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord said to Gideon, 'There are still too many people... I will sift them for you there.'

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: The sword of the Lord is working on my behalf to defeat every adversary— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: A sword for the Lord and for Gideon!

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I am exhausted but I keep up the pursuit until the mission is done— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Gideon and his three hundred men, exhausted yet keeping up the pursuit.

declarations.text: The Lord is my King and He is the one who rules over my life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will not rule over you... the Lord will rule over you.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I am a person of honor, and I stand tall even in difficult times— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Spirit of the Lord came on him, and he led Israel.

declarations.text: I am like the sun when it rises in its strength, shining brighter and brighter.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But may all who love you be like the sun when it rises in its strength.

declarations.text: I am a mother/father in my generation, bringing life and wisdom to those around me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Until I, Deborah, arose, arose a mother in Israel.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: My heart is with the willing people who offer themselves to God’s work— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: My heart is with Israel’s princes, with the willing volunteers among the people.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: Even the stars in their courses fight for me against my enemies— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: From the heavens the stars fought, from their courses they fought against Sisera.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I am set apart from the womb for a special work of God— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The boy is to be a Nazirite, dedicated to God from the womb.

declarations.text: The Spirit of the Lord begins to stir me and move me toward my purpose.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And the Spirit of the Lord began to stir him.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I have supernatural strength to tear down every lion that tries to stop me— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Spirit of the Lord came powerfully upon him so that he tore the lion apart.

declarations.text: Out of the eater comes something to eat, and out of the strong comes something sweet.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Out of the eater, something to eat; out of the strong, something sweet.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I am breaking every bond and cord that tries to hold me back— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Spirit of the Lord came powerfully upon him. The ropes on his arms became like charred flax.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I am refreshed by the stream of water that God provides for my thirst— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: God opened up the hollow place... and water came out of it. When Samson drank, his strength returned.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I am waking up and shaking off the enemy’s attempts to bind me— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He awoke from his sleep and thought, 'I’ll go out as before and shake myself free.'

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: God remembers me and gives me the strength I need one more time— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Sovereign Lord, remember me. Please, God, strengthen me just once more.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I am finishing my mission with more impact than I started with— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Thus he killed many more when he died than while he lived.

declarations.text: I choose to do what is right in the eyes of God, not just what is right in my own eyes.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In those days... everyone did as they saw fit.

declarations.text: I am a person of loyalty, and I am committed to the path God has set before me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Where you go I will go, and where you stay I will stay.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: The Lord is my God and His people are my people— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Your people will be my people and your God my God.

declarations.text: I find favor in the eyes of those who can help me fulfill my destiny.
declarations.bibleVerseText: May I continue to find favor in your eyes, my lord.

declarations.text: I am working in a field of favor where I am protected and provided for.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So Ruth stayed close to the women of Boaz to glean until the barley and wheat harvests were finished.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: The Lord is repaying me for all the good I have done for others— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: May the Lord repay you for what you have done.

declarations.text: I receive a full reward from the Lord under whose wings I have taken refuge.
declarations.bibleVerseText: May you be richly rewarded by the Lord... under whose wings you have come to take refuge.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I am a person of noble character, and everyone in my city knows it— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: All the people of my town know that you are a woman of noble character.

declarations.text: I will wait patiently because I know the Lord is working out the details of my life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Wait, my daughter, until you find out what happens. For the man will not rest until the matter is settled today.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: My Redeemer is active and He is restoring everything I thought was lost— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Praise be to the Lord, who this day has not left you without a guardian-redeemer.

declarations.text: My life is being renewed and I am sustained in my later years by God's goodness.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He will renew your life and sustain you in your old age.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I am part of a lineage of blessing that will impact generations to come— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Then Boaz took Ruth and she became his wife... and she gave birth to a son.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: God is turning my bitterness into sweetness and my emptiness into fullness— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I went away full, but the Lord has brought me back empty... [but later] the women said to Naomi: 'Praise be to the Lord!'

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I have more than enough because I walk in the favor of the harvest— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So she gleaned in the field until evening. Then she threshed the barley she had gathered, and it amounted to about an ephah.

declarations.text: I am kind to those who have suffered, and God is kind to me in return.
declarations.bibleVerseText: May the Lord show you kindness, as you have shown kindness to your dead husbands and to me.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I am not alone; God provides companions who love and support me— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Your daughter-in-law, who loves you and who is better to you than seven sons.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I am a restorer of hope in my family— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The women living there said, 'Naomi has a son!' And they named him Obed.

declarations.text: I walk in divine timing and find myself in the 'right field' at the right time.
declarations.bibleVerseText: As it turned out, she was working in a field belonging to Boaz.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I am blessed with spiritual and physical inheritance— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Boaz replied, 'I have been told all about what you have done...'

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I am humble and God exalts me in due time— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: At this, she bowed down with her face to the ground.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: My reputation precedes me as a person of integrity and hard work— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: She has been at it from morning till now, except for a short rest in the shelter.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I am a blessing to my elders and a joy to my community— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The women said to Naomi: 'Praise be to the Lord, who this day has not left you without a guardian-redeemer.'

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: God uses my ordinary days to accomplish His extraordinary plans— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Obed the father of Jesse, and Jesse the father of David.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I am covered by the garment of God's protection— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Spread the corner of your garment over me, since you are a guardian-redeemer.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I do not let fear stop me from choosing what is right— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But Ruth replied, 'Don’t urge me to leave you or to turn back from you.'

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I am a recipient of God's 'Hesed'—His loyal, covenant love— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord bless him! He has not stopped showing his kindness to the living and the dead.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I am a person of prayer, and the Lord remembers and answers my petitions— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So in due time Hannah became pregnant and gave birth to a son. She named him Samuel, saying, 'Because I asked the Lord for him.'

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: My heart rejoices in the Lord, and my strength is exalted in Him— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: My heart rejoices in the Lord; in the Lord my horn is lifted high.

declarations.text: There is no one holy like the Lord, and there is no Rock like my God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: There is no one holy like the Lord; there is no one besides you; there is no Rock like our God.

declarations.text: The Lord is a God who knows everything, and by Him my actions are weighed.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For the Lord is a God who knows, and by him deeds are weighed.

declarations.text: I am raised up from the dust to sit with princes and inherit a throne of honor.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He raises the poor from the dust... to seat them with princes.

declarations.text: It is not by my own strength that I prevail, but by the power of God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: It is not by strength that one prevails.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I am growing in stature and in favor with both the Lord and people— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And the boy Samuel continued to grow in stature and in favor with the Lord and with people.

declarations.text: I have ears to hear what the Spirit is saying; Speak, Lord, for your servant is listening.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Speak, Lord, for your servant is listening.

declarations.text: Not one of the words God speaks over my life will fall to the ground.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord was with Samuel as he grew up, and he let none of Samuel’s words fall to the ground.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I serve the Lord with all my heart and I put away all distractions— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Commit yourselves to the Lord and serve him only.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: Ebenezer! Thus far the Lord has helped me— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He named it Ebenezer, saying, 'Thus far the Lord has helped us.'

declarations.text: I am anointed by God for a specific task and His Spirit is changing me into a different person.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Spirit of the Lord will come powerfully upon you... and you will be changed into a different person.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I do what my hand finds to do, for God is with me— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do whatever your hand finds to do, for God is with you.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: God is giving me a new heart to fulfill His will— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: As Saul turned to leave Samuel, God changed Saul’s heart.

declarations.text: I will not be afraid, for the Lord will not reject me for His great name's sake.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For the sake of his great name the Lord will not reject his people.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: Nothing can hinder the Lord from saving, whether by many or by few— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Nothing can hinder the Lord from saving, whether by many or by few.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I value obedience over sacrifice and I listen to the voice of God— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: To obey is better than sacrifice, and to heed is better than the fat of rams.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I am not judged by my outward appearance; God looks at my heart— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: People look at the outward appearance, but the Lord looks at the heart.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I am anointed and the Spirit of the Lord rests powerfully upon me— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So Samuel took the horn of oil and anointed him... and from that day on the Spirit of the Lord came powerfully upon David.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I come against every giant in the name of the Lord of Hosts— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You come against me with sword and spear and javelin, but I come against you in the name of the Lord Almighty.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: The battle is the Lord’s and He gives me the victory— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For the battle is the Lord’s, and he will give all of you into our hands.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I behave myself wisely in all my ways, and the Lord is with me— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In everything he did he had great success, because the Lord was with him.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I find strength and encouragement in the Lord my God— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But David found strength in the Lord his God.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I pursue, I overtake, and I recover all that the enemy has stolen— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Pursue them... You will certainly overtake them and succeed in the rescue.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: God is my reliable helper in times of trouble— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Then Samuel took a stone... and called its name Ebenezer.

declarations.text: The Lord is establishing me and exalting my position for the sake of His people.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And David knew that the Lord had established him as king over Israel and had exalted his kingdom.

declarations.text: I am becoming stronger and stronger because the Lord God of Hosts is with me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And David became greater and greater, for the Lord, the God of hosts, was with him.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: The Lord has broken through my enemies before me like a bursting flood— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord has broken through my enemies before me like the bursting out of waters.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I celebrate before the Lord with all my might and with songs of joy— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: David and all Israel were celebrating with all their might before the Lord.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I am unafraid to be radical in my worship of the Lord— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will become even more undignified than this, and I will be humiliated in my own eyes.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: How great You are, Sovereign Lord! There is no one like You— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: How great you are, Sovereign Lord! There is no one like you, and there is no God but you.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: God is building a house for me and establishing my legacy forever— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord himself will establish a house for you.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I am confident that what God has promised concerning me will be done— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And now, Lord God, keep forever the promise you have made concerning your servant and his house.

declarations.text: I am a recipient of God's kindness even when I am in a 'Lo-debar' season.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Is there no one still left... to whom I can show God’s kindness?

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I eat at the King's table continually as one of His own children— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So Mephibosheth ate at David’s table like one of the king’s sons.

declarations.text: I am courageous and I fight manfully for my people and for the cities of my God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Be strong, and let us fight bravely for our people and the cities of our God.

declarations.text: I am a person after God's own heart, quick to repent and seek His face.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Then David said to Nathan, 'I have sinned against the Lord.'

declarations.text: God devises ways so that I, though once far off, may not remain estranged from Him.
declarations.bibleVerseText: God does not take away life; instead, he devises ways so that a banished person does not remain banished from him.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: The Lord is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord is my rock, my fortress and my deliverer.

declarations.text: In my distress I called to the Lord, and He heard my voice from His temple.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In my distress I called to the Lord... From his temple he heard my voice.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: The Lord is my lamp; He turns my darkness into light— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You, Lord, are my lamp; the Lord turns my darkness into light.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: With God's help I can advance against a troop and scale a wall— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: With your help I can advance against a troop; with my God I can scale a wall.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: God's way is perfect; the Lord's word is flawless— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: As for God, his way is perfect: The Lord’s word is flawless.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: It is God who arms me with strength and keeps my way secure— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: It is God who arms me with strength and keeps my way secure.

declarations.text: God makes my feet like the feet of a deer and enables me to stand on the heights.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He makes my feet like the feet of a deer; he causes me to stand on the heights.

declarations.text: The Lord's gentleness has made me great — and that is a covenant reality I walk in every single day.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You make your saving help my shield; your gentleness has made me great.

declarations.text: The Lord lives! Praised be my Rock! — and that is a covenant reality I walk in every single day.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord lives! Praised be my Rock! Exalted be my God, the Rock, my Savior!

declarations.text: The Spirit of the Lord speaks through me and His word is on my tongue.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Spirit of the Lord spoke through me; his word was on my tongue.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I am part of an everlasting covenant, ordered in all things and secure— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Has he not made with me an everlasting covenant, arranged and secured in every part?

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I will not offer to the Lord that which costs me nothing— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will not sacrifice to the Lord my God burnt offerings that cost me nothing.

declarations.text: I walk in the ways of the Lord so that I may prosper in everything I do.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Walk in obedience to him... so that you may prosper in all you do and wherever you go.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I ask for a discerning heart to distinguish between right and wrong— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So give your servant a discerning heart... to distinguish between right and wrong.

declarations.text: God is giving me wisdom and very great insight, as measureless as the sand on the seashore.
declarations.bibleVerseText: God gave Solomon wisdom and very great insight, and a breadth of understanding as measureless as the sand on the seashore.

declarations.text: The Lord has given me rest on every side; there is no adversary or disaster.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But now the Lord my God has given me rest on every side, and there is no adversary or disaster.

declarations.text: The glory of the Lord fills my life so that I am overwhelmed by His presence.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The priests could not perform their service because of the cloud, for the glory of the Lord filled his temple.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: There is no God like my God in heaven above or on earth below— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Lord, the God of Israel, there is no God like you in heaven above or on earth below.

declarations.text: God keeps His covenant of love with me as I follow Him with all my heart.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You who keep your covenant of love with your servants who continue wholeheartedly in your way.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: Not one word has failed of all the good promises God has given me— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Not one word has failed of all the good promises he gave through his servant Moses.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: My heart is fully committed to the Lord my God— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And may your hearts be fully committed to the Lord our God.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: The Lord hears my prayer and my plea for mercy— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I have heard the prayer and plea you have made before me.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I am a person of integrity and uprightness of heart— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: As for you, if you walk before me in integrity of heart and uprightness.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: The report of God's blessing in my life exceeds what people have heard— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Indeed, not even half was told me; in wisdom and wealth you have far exceeded the report I heard.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I am sustained by God's provision even in times of drought— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I have directed the ravens to supply you with food there.

declarations.text: My jar of flour will not be used up and my jug of oil will not run dry.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For this is what the Lord... says: 'The jar of flour will not be used up and the jug of oil will not run dry...'

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: The Lord—He is God! The Lord—He is God!— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: When all the people saw this, they fell prostrate and cried, 'The Lord—he is God! The Lord—he is God!'

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I hear the sound of a heavy rain; my breakthrough is coming— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Go, eat and drink, for there is the sound of a heavy rain.

declarations.text: The power of the Lord comes upon me and I outrun the chariots of the enemy.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The power of the Lord came on Elijah and... he ran ahead of Ahab all the way to Jezreel.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I listen for the gentle whisper of God's voice— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And after the fire came a gentle whisper.

declarations.text: I am not alone; God has reserved a remnant who have not bowed to the world.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Yet I reserve seven thousand in Israel—all whose knees have not bowed down to Baal.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I am ready to leave everything to follow the call of God— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So Elisha left his oxen and ran after Elijah.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I don't boast about starting a task, but I celebrate completing it in victory— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: One who puts on his armor should not boast like one who takes it off.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: The Lord is God of the mountains and God of the valleys— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Because the Arameans think the Lord is a god of the hills and not a god of the valleys, I will deliver this vast army into your hands.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I speak only what the Lord tells me to speak— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: As surely as the Lord lives, I can tell him only what the Lord tells me.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I am blessed because I am a servant of the King of kings— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: How happy your people must be! How happy your officials, who continually stand before you and hear your wisdom!

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: The Lord my God is with me as He was with my ancestors— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: May the Lord our God be with us as he was with our ancestors; may he never leave us nor forsake us.

declarations.text: I am receiving a double portion of God's Spirit for the work ahead of me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Please let a double portion of your spirit be upon me.

declarations.text: The obstacles in my path are parting as I apply the power of God's Word.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He took the cloak that had fallen from Elijah and struck the water with it... it divided to the right and to the left.

declarations.text: The bitter waters in my life are being made sweet and productive by the Lord.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I have healed this water. Never again will it cause death or make the land unproductive.

declarations.text: I am making my valley full of ditches, expecting God to fill them without wind or rain.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You will see neither wind nor rain, yet this valley will be filled with water.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: My small supply is multiplying supernaturally as I step out in obedience— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The oil stopped flowing only when there were no more jars.

declarations.text: I declare 'It is well' over my family and my future, even in the face of trial.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Everything is all right. It is well.

declarations.text: There is no limit to what God can do with what I have placed in His hands.
declarations.bibleVerseText: They will eat and have some left over.

declarations.text: I am washing in the 'Jordan' of God’s instructions and my flesh is being restored.
declarations.bibleVerseText: His flesh was restored and became clean like that of a young boy.

declarations.text: Now I know that there is no God in all the world except the God I serve.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Now I know that there is no God in all the world except in Israel.

declarations.text: The things that were lost and sunk are rising to the surface by God's power.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The iron head floated.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: Those who are with me are more than those who are against me— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Don't be afraid. Those who are with us are more than those who are with them.

declarations.text: My spiritual eyes are open to see the horses and chariots of fire protecting me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Then the Lord opened the servant’s eyes, and he looked and saw the hills full of horses and chariots of fire all around Elisha.

declarations.text: By this time tomorrow, my season of famine will be turned into a season of plenty.
declarations.bibleVerseText: About this time tomorrow... a seah of the finest flour will sell for a shekel.

declarations.text: I am not sitting here until I die; I am moving forward into God's provision.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Why stay here until we die?

declarations.text: The Lord has caused the enemy to hear a sound that sends them into retreat.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord had caused the Arameans to hear the sound of chariots and horses.

declarations.text: I am a herald of good news and I will not keep the blessings to myself.
declarations.bibleVerseText: This is a day of good news and we are keeping it to ourselves.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I am zealous for the Lord and I fulfill His commands with passion— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Come with me and see my zeal for the Lord.

declarations.text: I am striking the ground with my arrows of faith until the victory is complete.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He struck it three times and stopped... You should have struck the ground five or six times.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I am receiving life and resurrection power even from the legacies of the past— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: When the body touched Elisha’s bones, the man came to life and stood up on his feet.

declarations.text: I trust in the Lord so much that there is no one like me in my devotion.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Hezekiah trusted in the Lord... There was no one like him among all the kings of Judah.

declarations.text: I declare this over my life with full faith: I hold fast to the Lord and do not stop following Him— and I stand on this promise today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He held fast to the Lord and did not stop following him.

declarations.text: I take the 'letters' of the enemy's threats and spread them before the Lord in prayer.
