declarations.text: I receive grace upon grace and an endless supply covers every gap, every failure, and every lack.
declarations.bibleVerseText: From his fullness we have all received, grace upon grace.

declarations.text: My biggest mess became God's greatest message and that is exactly what grace does with a willing heart.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And we know that in all things God works for the good of those who love him.

declarations.text: I walk in the riches of God's grace where every debt is cancelled and every sin is fully forgiven.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In him we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, in accordance with the riches of God's grace.

declarations.text: I am justified by His grace and I live as a full heir of every promise He has made.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So that, having been justified by his grace, we might become heirs having the hope of eternal life.

declarations.text: I do not set aside the grace of God but make it the firm foundation of everything I am and everything I do.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I do not set aside the grace of God, for if righteousness could be gained through the law, Christ died for nothing.

declarations.text: I live under grace and not under the weight of works because grace is the ground I stand on.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And if by grace, then it cannot be based on works; if it were, grace would no longer be grace.

declarations.text: I receive the grace of God fully and let it produce everything He intended in my life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: As God's co-workers we urge you not to receive God's grace in vain.

declarations.text: I sleep in peace every night because God alone is my safety and my shelter.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In peace I will lie down and sleep, for you alone, Lord, make me dwell in safety.

declarations.text: I trade my heavy burdens for the rest that only God can give to my soul.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.

declarations.text: I choose stillness and trust that the Lord is already fighting on my behalf.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord will fight for you; you need only to be still.

declarations.text: I have a peace that makes no sense to the world because God is guarding my heart.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And the peace of God, which transcends all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds.

declarations.text: I find renewed strength by resting quietly in the presence of the Lord.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In repentance and rest is your salvation, in quietness and trust is your strength.

declarations.text: I am led by the Spirit to a place of quietness and total refreshment.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He makes me lie down in green pastures, he leads me beside quiet waters, he refreshes my soul.

declarations.text: I release every anxious thought and rest in the truth that God cares for every detail of my life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Cast all your anxiety on him because he cares for you.

declarations.text: I live in the shadow of the Almighty where no harm can ever reach me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Whoever dwells in the shelter of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.

declarations.text: I trust God to provide for me even while I am resting.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In vain you rise early and stay up late... for he grants sleep to those he loves.

declarations.text: I keep my mind focused on God and He keeps me in perfect peace.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You will keep in perfect peace those whose minds are steadfast, because they trust in you.

declarations.text: I find my true rest in God alone because He is the source of my hope.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Yes, my soul, find rest in God; my hope comes from him.

declarations.text: I walk through the day with a calm heart because God is right beside me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord is near to all who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.

declarations.text: I enter into God's rest by believing that His promises are already true for me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Now we who have believed enter that rest.

declarations.text: I can let go of the past because God's mercy is new every single morning.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Because of the Lord's great love we are not consumed... his compassions never fail. They are new every morning.

declarations.text: I am like a child resting safely in the arms of a loving Father.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But I have calmed and quieted myself, I am like a weaned child with its mother.

declarations.text: I let the peace of God rule over my heart and govern every decision I make.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts, since as members of one body you were called to peace.

declarations.text: I choose rest as an act of trust because God is my strength and my shield.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in him, and he helps me.

declarations.text: I enter the Sabbath rest God has prepared for His people and receive the renewal that only He can give.
declarations.bibleVerseText: There remains, then, a Sabbath-rest for the people of God.

declarations.text: I find deep satisfaction and rest simply by being close to God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You will fill me with joy in your presence, with eternal pleasures at your right hand.

declarations.text: I walk fully in the peace God has already given me and refuse to let anything steal it away.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord gives strength to his people; the Lord blesses his people with peace.

declarations.text: I rest in the fact that God is for me and nothing can stand against me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: What, then, shall we say in response to these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?

declarations.text: I close each day with gratitude and rest deeply in the goodness of the Lord.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Return to your rest, my soul, for the Lord has been good to you.

declarations.text: I lay down the weight I was never meant to carry and discover that His yoke is lighter than I ever imagined.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.

declarations.text: I work from a place of rest and not rest from a place of exhaustion because that is the rhythm of kingdom life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In repentance and rest is your salvation, in quietness and trust is your strength.

declarations.text: I silence the noise, still my soul, and find that God has been speaking the whole time.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Be still, and know that I am God.

declarations.text: Even when life is loud and my mind is racing I carry a secret place of peace within me and I return there now.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Whoever dwells in the shelter of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.

declarations.text: I dwell in the rest of God where striving ceases and His strength sustains me through every season.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But those who hope in the Lord will renew their strength. They will soar on wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary, they will walk and not be faint.

declarations.text: I am still in my spirit because I know the One who holds the universe also holds every detail of my life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: When you lie down, you will not be afraid; when you lie down, your sleep will be sweet.

declarations.text: My peace is not dependent on my circumstances but anchored in the unchanging faithfulness of God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Peace I leave with you; my peace I give you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled and do not be afraid.

declarations.text: I receive the deep rest that flows from knowing God loves me, keeps me, and is never finished working on my behalf.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord your God is with you, the Mighty Warrior who saves. He will take great delight in you; in his love he will no longer rebuke you, but will rejoice over you with singing.
